findings.location: 새 확인과 전이 — '새 상황 B ... 보기 없이 익힌 부탁을 만들어요' immediately followed by trilingual '답 ... B 모자 주세요'
findings.problem: The response is meant to distinguish a supplied choice from self-produced input, but the full B answer appears in the next visible table row and no instruction hides it or the prior models. As a learner-facing page this permits copying while being classified as self-produced input.
findings.proposal: Insert before the two situation tasks, in all three languages: '앞의 어휘표·모형과 다음 답 행을 가리고 상황 A/B 문제 행만 보세요. A는 보기 선택 뒤 입력이며, B는 모형 없이 익힌 요청을 떠올리는 확인입니다. 도움을 보면 지원 연습으로 구별합니다. / Cover the glossary, earlier models and the answer row below. Look only at the situation A/B task row. A is entering a selected option; B is recalling the familiar request without a model. If you use a model, record supported practice. / Decke die Wortliste, die bisherigen Vorbilder und die folgende Lösungszeile ab. Sieh nur die Aufgabenzeile A/B an. Bei A gibst du eine gewählte Option ein; bei B erinnerst du dich ohne Vorbild an die bekannte Bitte. Mit Vorbild gilt der Versuch als gestützte Übung.' Move the whole trilingual answer row into a separate '진행자용 답 — 응답 뒤 공개 / Facilitator answers—reveal after responding / Lösungen für die Kursleitung—erst nach der Antwort zeigen' block. B accepts 모자 주세요 and context-appropriate 모자를 주세요 if supplied spontaneously; the latter is not newly required grammar.
